title: Persona template
description: A named, versioned set of configuration applied in one step (#16772, docs/web/web.md "Templates", docs/protocol/protocol.md "Templates"). Each part is applied where it belongs: browser looks by the app, navigation through PUT /api/v1/navigation, extensions through their own routes, settings through POST /api/v1/templates/settings. A template never carries secrets. The web app's parser (web/src/lib/templates.ts parseTemplate) reads the same fields.

Localized.description: One string, or one per language.

Browser.description: This browser's looks. modules_off is the whole list of optional web modules switched off: every other one is switched on.

main_chat.description: plain: the main conversation as questions and replies (#16898).

agents_view.description: active: Agents lists only the sessions running now, by computer (#16898).

settings_view.description: short: Settings lists a few categories, the rest under More settings (#16898).

sidebar_view.description: agents: the sidebar has the main chat and the Agents only, no Pages or Persona chats sections (#16898).

Pages.description: The sidebar's page arrangement as the navigation record keeps it (docs/protocol/protocol.md "Navigation").

Navigation.description: The hub's navigation: every device follows it. pages: null puts the sidebar back to its default.

Extension.description: An installed extension: whether it is on, and configuration fields merged over its current configuration. An extension that is not installed is skipped.

Setting.description: A persona_settings key with the action its setting takes. Settings that grant permissions or speak for the owner are refused.
